flag.prompt: Ask once and leave, without a conversation
flag.cwd: Which folder; the current one when empty
flag.name: The own agent's name (its home is ~/.vibevalley/agent/<name>)
flag.mcp: The MCP configuration file; mcp.json in the home when empty
flag.server: The server's address; VIBEVALLEY_SERVER when empty, else the one running on this machine (the home's server.json), else {fallback}
flag.dryRun: Only say what it would do, without doing it (commands that delete, merge, close or send a helper away)
flag.json: The request body: JSON text, - to read stdin, @file to read a file
flag.watch: Keep watching: one JSON line per frame
flag.format: md: Markdown to read (the default); json: the endpoint's answer
flag.capturePage: At the end of this page (its title, slug or an alias); none: today's journal
flag.day: Which day's journal, YYYY-MM-DD; none: today
flag.agent: A profile: its id or name
flag.at: When to run once, such as 2026-11-05T09:00
flag.channel: Which channel to say it in
flag.criterion: An acceptance criterion; give it more than once
flag.key: A request key: sent again with the same key, it is done once
flag.module: Only this module's endpoints, such as pkm
flag.noWait: Come back once it is sent, not when it is handed back
flag.text: Words the title or description contains
flag.timeout: Wait at most this many seconds
flag.waiting: Only those waiting on the owner
flag.probe: Look for every runtime again first (after installing or upgrading one)
flag.diff: Add its change: commits and files
flag.searchIn: Search only these: issues, channels, notes, memory (may be given more than once)
flag.searchLimit: At most this many from each

command.root: One thing to do with the farm per command: answers are short text, --format json gives the protocol's shape; guide says how to use them, chat talks in the terminal

app.about: The desktop app itself: its status, a page to open, updates, quitting
app.open: Bring the desktop window to this page (/issues/12), opening the app if it is not
app.quit: Quit the desktop app (its server saves first)
app.update: The desktop app's update: as it stands with no argument, check to look now, install to put it in place and restart

command.doctor: See this machine's farm at once: which one was found, whether it answers, the desktop app, runtimes, the model's key, the LAN listener

pkm.capture: Note something in today's journal (--page: on that page); no words reads stdin, lines split into blocks by indentation
pkm.show: A page as Markdown to read (refs read out, remarks taken off); with no page, today's journal (--day for another day)
pkm.list: List notes pages, the latest changed first
pkm.edit: Edit a whole page's file in $EDITOR; it is saved when the editor closes
pkm.radar: What wants a look: the inbox, projects left alone, what is overdue

agent.list: List profiles: id, name, role, runtime
agent.show: Show a profile: its duty, runtime and model, skills

api.about: Use the endpoints directly: list them, call one, follow the state stream
api.call: Call an endpoint, --json checked against its Schema before it is sent
api.list: List every endpoint and what it does; --format json adds its request body's JSON Schema

artifact.show: Show a draft: its title, version and owner, then its words

cron.new: Make a scheduled task: give one of --every, --daily, --cron, --at

command.guide: How an agent does the common things, step by step

issue.edit: Change an issue's title, description, project, profile or priority
issue.list: List issues: one a line, number first
issue.show: Show an issue: where it stands, its questions and criteria, what can be done now (--diff adds its change, --log its timeline and cost)
issue.work: Send it out: start it (go on when stuck, reopen a closed one first), wait for the hand-back, print the change
issue.say: Talk to the issue's helper: an answer when it asks, sending it back when it waits for review, else a word passed on
issue.accept: Accept the work: the issue is done

memory.add: Note a memory for a profile

project.new: Make a project (--repo clones it from GitHub)

runtime.list: List the runtimes: installed or not, versions (--probe looks again first)

session.list: List helpers: id, name, profile, what it is doing

command.search: Search the whole farm: issues, what was said in channels, notes, memories, each under its own heading
command.chat: Talk in the terminal: with no runtime, VibeValley's own agent; with one, that runtime directly (no trajectory, no spending)

next.help: See how this command is written
next.startServer: Start the server first (vp run --filter @vibevalley/server start), or point --server at one that runs
next.openApp: Open the desktop app first (vibevalley app open opens it too)

failure.dryRun: {op} changes things, but has no dry run: drop --dry-run to do it
failure.retry: The server asked the stream to reconnect; the command line does not
failure.gone: Ticket #{n} is gone: it was deleted
failure.appNotOpen: Cannot reach the desktop app of {home}: {why}
failure.ambiguous: More than one {what} is "{said}": {these}. Be more exact, or use the id
failure.noDryRun: {command} has no dry run: drop --dry-run to do it
failure.noChat: VibeValley's conversation program is not found here: use the command line the desktop app installs, or vp run --filter @vibevalley/cli start in the repository
failure.chatFlag: {flags} cannot go with {runtime}: --name and --mcp are VibeValley's own agent's, --effort and --resume a runtime's

markdown.get: Read a block artifact as Markdown

artifact.previewDelete: Preview deleting an artifact: say what would go, without deleting

version.create: Hand in a new version of an HTML artifact; the old ones stay

archive.set: Archive a channel or bring it back; its messages stay

attachment.create: Upload an attachment for a message

default.set: Make a channel the default: where anything unaddressed goes

channel.delete: Delete a channel with its threads and messages

direct.create: Open a direct message with a profile, made if there is none

channel.list: List every channel and direct message, the default first
channel.markRead: Mark read up to a message
channel.markUnread: Mark unread from a message on

notify.set: Set a channel's notifications: all, mentions or none

pin.list: List a channel's pinned messages, newest pinned first

channel.previewDelete: Preview deleting a channel: say what would go, without deleting

reaction.set: Add or take back a reaction on a message

thread.create: Open the thread under a message, made if there is none

unread.list: List the places with unread messages, newest first

channel.set: Choose the channel a connector's messages go to

connector.list: List the WeChat, Feishu and QQ connectors and how they stand

cron.previewDelete: Preview deleting a scheduled task: say what would go, without deleting

title.set: Pick the title shown on the farm card

github.get: Whether gh is installed and logged in
github.refresh: Check GitHub again and refresh the open PRs

comment.create: Comment on a ticket; its newest helper hears it

diff.get: A ticket's changes: commits, files and diff

history.list: Tickets with their helper history, missing records included

issue.list: List tickets: the open ones by default, newest first
issue.previewDelete: Preview deleting a ticket: say what would go, without deleting

issue.review: Review what was handed back: pass or send back; completing is a separate move

run.list: List a ticket's rounds of work

status.previewUpdate: Preview moving a ticket: say what would happen, without moving it

timeline.get: A ticket's milestones and what all its rounds cost

device.previewDelete: Preview removing a device: say what would go, without removing it

lan.get: Whether connect to this machine is on, and its devices

me.get: The device this request comes from

pairing.answer: Allow or refuse the device asking to pair

lan.update: Turn connect to this machine on or off

memory.create: Add a memory to a profile
memory.delete: Delete one of a profile's memories
memory.list: List a profile's memories, from the database and its sources
memory.previewDelete: Preview deleting a memory: say what would go, without deleting
memory.recall: What a profile would recall for this project and text
memory.search: Search memories by words, every profile's if none is named

archive.get: Read one of the manager's archived conversations
archive.list: List or search the manager's archived conversations

eval.create: Save a manager turn that went wrong as an eval case, with what it should have done

block.apply: Apply block operations to a page in order, written back once

pkm.capture: Note a line in today's journal, tagged #inbox

clip.create: Clip a web page into a resource page

cluster.create: Gather the blocks about a topic into a resource page

comment.list: List remarks and suggested rewrites, one page's if given

comment.suggest: Suggest a rewrite of a block, keeping its links and refs

journal.open: Open a day's journal, made if there is none

page.export: Export a page as plain Markdown
page.get: Get a page with its refs read out, its backlinks and open remarks
page.list: List every page in the notes, newest first
page.move: Move a page to another PARA folder
page.rename: Rename a page or merge it into one of that name; links follow
page.save: Create a page, or set the properties and folder of the one with that title

radar.get: The review radar: inbox pages, stale projects, overdue blocks

pkm.scan: Read again every note file changed on disk

source.get: A page's file as written, block ids and all, and when it was last written

activity.get: A project's commits: how many per day, and by whom

language.list: The languages a project is written in

template.list: A project's ticket templates, filled in for its stack

health.get: Whether the server is up, and its version

voice.dictate: Dictate: turn a recording into text
